question: In May 2025, which initiative was launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh in his capacity as MoS PMO and MoS Personnel?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**e-Civil List 2025 (e-book)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **e-Civil List** is a digital initiative launched by the **Government of India** to provide an **e-book** version of the Civil List, which contains comprehensive information about the **Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers.**
 
• The initiative was launched by **Dr. Jitendra Singh**, who serves as the **Minister of State (MoS) for Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions**, among other roles.
 
• The list offers details such as **service records, postings, batch years, and educational qualifications** of IAS officers in a digital format, making it more accessible and efficient.
 
• This move aligns with the government's broader push towards **digital governance** and aims to enhance **transparency** in administration.
 
• The **e-book format** ensures ease of access for stakeholders and is also an environmentally friendly alternative to paper-based records.
 
• The e-Civil List is part of the government’s mission to integrate **technology into administrative processes** and improve the overall efficiency of governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Central Services Digital Archive**__

 __
 
• This could be a hypothetical initiative aimed at creating a **digital repository** for the records of Central Services officers. However, as of now, no such initiative has been officially launched.
 
 
 
• **National Governance Dashboard**__
 __
 
• Such a dashboard would likely be designed to **track and monitor governance metrics** across various government departments, enhancing accountability and transparency. However, it is not related to the **e-Civil List 2025**.
 
 
 
• **Digital Pension Tracker**__
 
 
• This initiative would focus on using digital platforms to **track and manage pension disbursements** for retired government employees. While important, it does not pertain to the initiative launched in May 2025 by Dr. Jitendra Singh.
